mission: Design the first executable repository Context Fabric prototype with inventory, typed metadata, domain digests, graph edges, incremental invalidation, context receipts and a smallest end-to-end canary, without mutating shared architecture/authority heads.

source_freshness.note: Live main advanced during execution from independent workers. Candidate design uses source_head + per-artifact hashes explicitly so derived context can detect this class of drift.

useful_delta: Converted Context Fabric direction into a concrete deterministic repository-first implementation blueprint: exact source/config/script/test/projection/receipt paths; artifact/edge/digest/receipt schemas; metadata extraction rules; Merkle-style incremental invalidation; deterministic structured+lexical+graph retrieval; a gold-set canary; and falsifiers for stale context, authority confusion, contradiction omission, privacy leakage, rename/delete handling and oversized working sets.
facts: The binding Context Fabric direction keeps Git as canonical/auditable truth and treats manifests, graph, retrieval indexes and database rows as derived/rebuildable projections.
Current Prometeo runtime generation is already Node ESM, filesystem/Git driven, deterministic-hash based and tested with node:assert; the prototype can reuse that stack without adding a dependency.
No context-fabric-prefixed implementation was found in the current scripts/tests directory listings, and tests/fixtures already exists as the established fixture location.
Continuity Head is a compact manually seeded projection until a compiler exists and explicitly marks Context Fabric use as unproven.
Current queue/run/return contracts already expose many typed identifiers and refs needed for deterministic graph extraction; semantic inference is not required for the first graph.

route_choice.reason: It can be implemented and falsified immediately with the repository's existing Node/Git/hash/test patterns, produces auditable receipts, and does not make a database/vector service an authority or availability dependency.

alternatives.reason: Useful as a later acceleration/index projection, but unnecessary for the first end-to-end proof and would add schema/deployment/credential/extension questions before retrieval correctness is established.

Adds nondeterminism and makes bootstrap/falsification harder. First prove exact metadata, explicit graph edges, hashes, lexical retrieval and receipts; then add generated prose digests/embeddings as derived enrichments.

implementation_sequence: P0 contracts/config: define discovery roots, excludes, namespace mapping, authority/privacy extraction and output schemas.
P1 deterministic inventory+graph+namespace manifests: scan candidate files, parse metadata, hash content, derive explicit typed edges, emit rebuildable JSON projections.
P1 context compiler: structured filters -> exact identifiers/codes -> lexical score -> graph expansion -> authority/freshness/contradiction constraints -> token/file budget.
P1 durable receipt integration: compiler emits a receipt payload; execution caller persists the sanitized append-only receipt before material work.
P1 canary: build fixture and live-repo index, compile one planner mission, compare selected working set with a gold critical-source set, then run falsifiers.
P2 optional derived service: mirror inventory/chunks/edges/digests/receipts into Supabase/Postgres and add FTS/embeddings only after P1 passes.

exact_files_to_build_first.role: Canonical candidate configuration for include/exclude roots, namespace rules, authority/privacy mappings, allowed parsers, generator_version and default context budgets.
Candidate contract containing artifact, namespace digest, typed-edge, working-set and context-receipt schemas. Contract only; not product authority.

Pure deterministic helpers: path normalization, artifact ids, SHA-256, JSON/Markdown metadata extraction, explicit reference extraction, edge derivation, namespace Merkle hashes, lexical scoring, graph expansion and budget selection. Reuse sha256/norm/uniq/assertPublicSafe patterns from agent-network-lib.mjs where practical.
CLI builder. Reads config + Git/source tree, performs full or incremental scan, emits inventory/graph/namespaces/build-state under dist/context-fabric/ with stable sorting.

CLI compiler accepting actor role, mission, project/root/opportunity/run, tools/capabilities, privacy, freshness and budget; consumes only the prebuilt projections at query time and emits Working Set + receipt payload.
Small isolated fixture graph including current, candidate, contradiction, private, stale, rename/delete and dependency cases.

candidate.receipt_write_rule: Append-only unique receipt file, persisted by the execution caller before material work. The compiler may first emit the payload under dist; dist alone does not satisfy durable verification. Receipt persistence grants no authority and contains only sanitized/public coordination metadata for public workers.

artifact_schema.identity: artifact_id = A- + first 16 hex of sha256(normalized repository path). A Git rename produces a new path identity plus explicit RENAMED_FROM lineage derived from Git status.
artifact_schema.authority_rule: authority_class is extracted only from explicit durable authority/status fields/path rules/config. Similarity score never creates CURRENT/HUMAN_ACCEPTED/SERVED authority.

edge_schema.edge_id: E- + first 16 hex of sha256(src_id + edge_type + dst_ref + evidence_ref + evidence_pointer)
edge_schema.derivation: Map explicit fields/ref patterns such as project_id, chat_object_id, workstream_id, parent_chat_object_id, opportunity_id, work_item_id, claim_ref, run_ref, return_ref, depends_on, needs, provides, basis, source_refs, *_ref, supersedes and blocker refs. Keep unresolved targets as warnings instead of fabricating nodes.

namespace_digest_schema.first_pass_summary: Deterministic manifest-style digest from structured metadata and exact refs; generated natural-language summaries may be added later with provenance but are not required for P1 correctness.

context_receipt_schema.receipt_id: CR- + timestamp + '-' + first 12 hex of sha256(actor_role + mission + source_head + sorted selected artifact hashes).
context_receipt_schema.audit_rule: Each selected artifact records path, content_hash, namespace, role in L0/L1/L2, selection reason and authority label; omissions are explicit rather than invisible.

metadata_extraction.json: Parse JSON when valid; collect schema, status/state, owner, project/chat/workstream/opportunity/work-item/run identifiers, refs, dependencies, blockers, authority/privacy fields and arrays. Preserve JSON-pointer evidence locations.
metadata_extraction.markdown: Deterministically extract title (first H1), leading Status:/Owner:/Schema: fields, fenced/inline durable identifiers, repository paths/URLs, and selected headings. Do not ask an LLM to decide authority.
metadata_extraction.other_text: Record path/hash/kind and lexical tokens only unless a specific parser is configured.
metadata_extraction.privacy: Run assertPublicSafe-equivalent checks on public projection/receipt payloads; private source content is not copied into public digests.

algorithm: Resolve current Git HEAD and load prior build-state.
If no prior state, config/generator version changed, prior head is missing, or prior head is not an ancestor of current head: full safe rebuild.
Else run git diff --name-status <prior_head>..<current_head> limited to configured roots.
For added/modified files: recompute content_hash and parsed metadata_hash. If neither changes, reuse downstream projections.
For deletes: remove artifact and its explicit outgoing/incoming derived edges; mark containing namespace dirty.
For renames: create new path-derived artifact id, record RENAMED_FROM lineage using Git status, and invalidate old/new namespaces.
If metadata_hash changes, recompute explicit edges and structured filters for that artifact.
If content_hash or metadata_hash changes, dirty containing namespace and ancestors.

Namespace merkle_hash = sha256(generator_version + config_hash + sorted child artifact id/content_hash/metadata_hash tuples + sorted child namespace merkle hashes). Reuse digest if merkle hash unchanged.
graph_input_hash = sha256(sorted explicit edge source tuples). Reuse graph when unchanged.
index_hash = sha256(source_head + config_hash + inventory hash + graph hash + namespace index hash).
Every compiled Working Set verifies its source_head/index_hash and each selected artifact content_hash; mismatch => STALE_INDEX_FAIL_CLOSED, rebuild/recompile rather than silently use stale context.

selection_pipeline: 1 inject mandatory L0 kernel refs from role/root policy (constitution, authority/current frontier, verification/non-regression where strategic)
2 structured lookup for exact project/chat/workstream/opportunity/run identifiers
3 exact lexical/code lookup across artifact metadata and tokens
5 score remaining candidates by mission lexical relevance + authority/dependency/contradiction/freshness/evidence need - redundancy/token cost
6 force-include conflicting evidence and authority boundary refs when a selected node declares them
7 enforce file/token budget only after protected critical inclusions; emit explicit omitted-but-available refs
8 emit Working Set and receipt with per-item reason

phase2_supabase_projection.rule: Rows are derived/rebuildable from Git + durable authorized sources; database/vector similarity is never the sole authority/currentness source.
phase2_supabase_projection.retrieval: Start with structured indexes + Postgres FTS. Add embeddings only after verifying available extension/model and a canary shows semantic recall materially improves over lexical+graph without authority regressions.

canary.name: CONTEXT-FABRIC-P1-GOLDSET-CANARY
canary.goal: Prove a fresh planner can find the critical sources for a real Prometeo Context Fabric mission from a prebuilt index without repository scanning at query time.

input.mission: Design the first executable repository Context Fabric prototype with inventory, incremental invalidation and durable context receipts.

pass_conditions: All gold critical sources appear in L0/L1/L2 or as the exact source behind an included digest.
Query-time filesystem/repository scan count is zero; compile-context consumes the prebuilt projections.
selected_files <= 12 and selected_files/inventory_total <= 0.15 unless protected critical inclusions make the ratio impossible on a tiny fixture.
Receipt records source_head/index_hash, selected content hashes, reasons, authority labels and omissions.
A repeated build with unchanged sources/config is byte-stable except explicitly volatile timestamps, which must be excluded from semantic hashes.
Changing one fixture source invalidates that artifact and affected namespace ancestors but leaves unrelated namespace merkle hashes unchanged.

falsifiers.fail_if: Any gold source is absent with no equivalent exact-source-backed digest pointer.
After fixture content changes, compile-context returns a receipt with the old selected content hash or old namespace merkle.

falsifiers.setup: Fixture candidate has stronger lexical overlap than an explicit CURRENT_FOR/authority source.
falsifiers.fail_if: Candidate is labeled Current/Human Accepted/Served or displaces the mandatory authority source solely by score.

falsifiers.setup: Relevant node has explicit CONTRADICTS edge to another artifact.
falsifiers.fail_if: Compiler includes one side but omits the contradiction or fails to list it in receipt.

falsifiers.setup: Private fixture contains a secret-shaped field and is linked to a public root.
falsifiers.fail_if: Secret/private payload is copied into a public manifest/receipt.
Renamed/deleted fixture remains selectable under the old live path without lineage/tombstone evidence.
Non-critical candidates exceed budget instead of being omitted with pointers.
compile-context traverses repository source files rather than using the built projections.

evidence_outputs: test stdout JSON with pass/fail per falsifier

acceptance_matrix.criterion: concrete schema/files/scripts or tables are named
acceptance_matrix.evidence: Candidate lists exact config/schema/scripts/tests/fixtures, derived output paths, five optional Supabase tables, and field-level artifact/edge/digest/receipt contracts.
Algorithm specifies Git diff fast path, full-rebuild boundaries, per-artifact content/metadata hashes, rename/delete behavior, namespace Merkle hashes, graph/index hashes and fail-closed freshness.
Append-only durable path coordination/context-receipts/<YYYY>/<MM>/<receipt_id>.json with receipt id/hash rules and dist-only payload explicitly insufficient for durable proof.

acceptance_matrix.criterion: smallest runnable canary and falsifiers are explicit
acceptance_matrix.evidence: P1 gold-set planner canary defines input, critical source set, pass thresholds, evidence outputs and eight falsifiers.

proof_refs.use: Binding direction: four-layer model, Git truth + derived index, receipts, implementation order.
Durable context receipt evidence requirements and falsification principle.
Explicit project/chat-object/workstream identities for structured extraction.
Current compact frontier and evidence that Context Fabric remains unproven/manual-seed dependent.
Opportunity fields, dependency/authority/privacy constraints and Planner interface.
Run lifecycle and typed parent/work item/return refs.
Durable identity/state pointers and authority separation.
Existing Node/Git/hash derived-runtime pattern to extend rather than replace.
Existing node:assert test style and generated-runtime invariants.

important_omitted_but_available_refs: Individual Supabase migration bodies were not required to choose the P1 repository-first route.
Vector extension/model availability was not assumed or inspected because embeddings are intentionally Phase 2.
Repository-wide source contents were deliberately not scanned; this worker used only opportunity scope plus a focused schema/runtime sample.
contradictions_or_freshness_findings: CONTINUITY_HEAD records all eight acceleration opportunities unclaimed at its final refresh, while live claims appeared seconds later. This is expected projection staleness and directly motivates source_head/index_hash validation in receipts.
context_receipt_completion.estimated_context_strategy: Focused L0/L1 plus 14 exact/source-layout reads; avoided whole-repository archaeology.

unresolved_boundaries: This return intentionally does not implement shared scripts/config/migrations because opportunity write_scope is claim + own run + own return only.
Embedding model, pgvector availability, database RLS and deployment details remain Phase 2 decisions after deterministic P1 retrieval passes.
Natural-language digest generation policy remains optional; first-pass digests are deterministic manifests so correctness does not depend on model summaries.

proposals.mission: Implement CONFIG_V1 + SCHEMA_V1 + context-fabric-lib/build/compile scripts + test fixtures exactly as the P1 repository-first blueprint, run the gold-set canary, and persist a real context receipt.
dependencies: parent/steward approval of candidate file scope
proposals.expected_value: Turns Context Fabric from DESIGNED_NOT_USED into an executable deterministic retrieval substrate.
proposals.falsification: Do not promote if any F1-F8 canary fails.

proposals.mission: Only after P1 pass, mirror derived artifacts/edges/digests/receipts into Supabase/Postgres, add FTS, then test whether embeddings improve critical-source recall enough to justify complexity.
proposals.expected_value: Lower-latency retrieval and semantic recall at larger scale without moving authority out of Git.
proposals.falsification: Retire embeddings if they do not improve recall/latency on a representative gold set or introduce authority/currentness regressions.
